headline: Russian Drone Onslaught Targets Ukrainian Infrastructure as IDF Elevates Alert
subheadline: Over 10 energy infrastructure objects damaged in single night of Russian attacks, leaving 550,000 families without electricity.
lede: Russian forces launched a coordinated drone and missile offensive across Ukraine, striking energy infrastructure and civilian areas in multiple regions. Ukrainian air defenses intercepted several Geran-5 drones, though significant damage and casualties were reported, including 14 injuries in Nova Vodolaha. Meanwhile, the IDF has placed military on highest alert ahead of October 27 elections, with special forces arresting multiple terror suspects near Jerusalem.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Target Ukrainian Grid
sections.body: Russian forces launched multiple Geran-5 drones and missiles across Ukraine, targeting energy infrastructure and civilian areas in Kyiv, Lviv, Rivne, and other regions. Ukrainian air defenses shot down several Geran-5 drones, with some projectiles manually guided and equipped with cameras. Over 10 energy infrastructure objects were damaged during a single night of attacks, leaving more than 550,000 families without electricity across 10 regions. At least 14 people were injured, including seven children, after a Russian strike on a central park in Nova Vodolaha.

sections.title: IDF on High Alert Ahead of Elections
sections.body: The IDF has placed military on highest alert and frozen leave ahead of October 27 elections, with reinforcements deployed to the West Bank. Israeli special forces of the Yamam police unit arrested Palestinian terrorists at the Latrun interchange while preparing an attack. Two suspects planning a terror attack were captured on Route 1 near Jerusalem. Eight Israeli suspects were arrested on suspicion of participating in settler attacks on Palestinians, foreign diplomats, and a photojournalist in the West Bank.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Both conflict zones show intensified military activity with expanded targeting of civilian infrastructure and critical systems. The Russian use of manually guided drones and satellite maneuvers suggests evolving tactical capabilities, while Israeli preemptive arrests indicate heightened domestic security concerns ahead of elections. Diplomatic initiatives, including Trump's proposed trilateral summit, emerge amid escalating regional tensions.
